'''Minister of Finance''' was a position on the [[Ruling Council (New Mandalorians)/Legends|Ruling Council]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a [[Unidentified New Mandalorian Minister of Finance/Legends|woman]] held the position.
